init.title: Heating price optimizers
init.description: Configure deterministic DHW readiness and retention policy, floor-optimizer room sources, and the explicit climate allowlist for extreme-price protection. Saving options does not enable writes. Write-capable heating modes still require their evidence gate or an explicit owner-approved activation, while Solar remains Shadow-only and every device guard and ownership check remains mandatory. {error}

get_prices.name: Get household price window
get_prices.description: Return published quarter-hour marginal import costs and net export earnings. Missing market or tariff coverage is explicitly marked; monthly fees and invoice finalization are excluded.

get_price_forecast.name: Get seven-day household price forecast
get_price_forecast.description: Return published and predicted quarter-hour all-in import prices. Forecast quantiles are advisory, monthly fees are excluded, and missing canonical published prices remain unavailable.

view.name: View
view.description: Current seven-day outlook or retained forecast issuances.

history_days.name: Archive history (days)
history_days.description: Archive view only: include delivery hours from the last 1 to 90 days.

horizon_days.name: Provider horizon day
horizon_days.description: Archive view only: select the D-1 through D-7 prediction horizon.

include_future_days.name: Future delivery days
include_future_days.description: Archive view only: also return stored forecasts through the end of the next 0 to 7 Tallinn delivery days. Use this to retain a prediction for comparison after official prices publish.

delivery_date.name: Delivery date
delivery_date.description: Evolution view only: select one Europe/Tallinn delivery date.

all_horizons.name: Combine provider horizons
all_horizons.description: Evolution view only: combine retained D-1 through D-7 issuances for the selected delivery date. Disabled preserves the selected single horizon.

quote_electricity_interval.name: Quote a household electricity interval
quote_electricity_interval.description: Calculate exactly one 15-minute interval, including tariff charges and VAT but excluding monthly fees. Quantities are interval kWh, not power.

start.name: Interval start
start.description: ISO timestamp with UTC offset, such as 2026-08-03T10:00:00+03:00.

end.name: Interval end
end.description: Exactly 15 minutes after start, with its UTC offset.

consumption_kwh.name: Imported energy (kWh)
consumption_kwh.description: Decimal strings preserve precision. Missing is not zero.

export_kwh.name: Exported energy (kWh)
export_kwh.description: Supply both raw directions when quarter-hour netting applies.

quantity_basis.name: Quantity basis
quantity_basis.description: Raw metered flows or already billable quantities; never net billable quantities twice.

price_basis.name: Price basis
price_basis.description: Published prices are retrieved automatically. Supplied future prices require estimate.

price_intervals.name: Explicit estimated prices
price_intervals.description: Estimate only: a list of start, end and price_eur_mwh objects, excluding VAT.

calculate_electricity_period.name: Calculate a household electricity bill or period
calculate_electricity_period.description: Choose a bill preset or custom calendar dates/length. Automatic metering needs private Elering credentials. Current month-to-date includes full monthly fees and explicitly reports incomplete metering coverage; no missing usage is zero-filled.

period.name: Period
period.description: Current month-to-date, previous complete month, last 12 complete months, or custom dates/length.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Custom periods only; calendar date in Europe/Tallinn.

end_date.name: Inclusive end date
end_date.description: Custom periods only. Omit for one day, or use days instead.

days.name: Length in calendar days
days.description: Custom periods only. With a start date, counts forward; without one, selects the latest completed days.

intervals.name: Supplied quarter-hour energy
intervals.description: Optional list of start, end, consumption_kwh and export_kwh objects. Both flows and complete coverage are required. Omit to use actual Elering readings.

quantity_basis.name: Quantity basis
quantity_basis.description: Automatic Elering readings are raw. Use billable only for already netted supplied quantities.

mode.name: Accounting mode
mode.description: Auto selects the preset's accounting. Report allocates monthly fees by calendar day; monthly requires complete calendar months. Keep auto for month-to-date.

include_daily.name: Include daily analytical breakdown
include_daily.description: Daily fixed-fee allocations are not additive finalized invoice lines.

price_basis.name: Price basis
price_basis.description: Actual-bill presets require published prices. Custom planning estimates need supplied energy and explicitly estimated prices.

price_intervals.name: Explicit estimated prices
price_intervals.description: Estimate only: complete 15-minute start/end/price_eur_mwh objects, excluding VAT. Never a fallback for an actual bill.

estimate_electricity_scenario.name: Estimate an appliance or grid-profile change
estimate_electricity_scenario.description: Calculate additional variable cost or saving with the same tariffs and VAT rules. Unchanged monthly fees are excluded; no appliance consumption, solar or battery behavior is inferred.

mode.name: Scenario
mode.description: Load assumes additional billable grid import; comparison prices supplied before/after grid profiles.

start.name: Load start
start.description: Load only: ISO timestamp with UTC offset.

power_kw.name: Constant load power (kW)
power_kw.description: Load only: supply this or energy_kwh, never both.

energy_kwh.name: Uniform load energy (kWh)
energy_kwh.description: Load only: explicit hypothetical energy, not a redistributed meter total.

baseline_intervals.name: Baseline grid profile
baseline_intervals.description: Comparison only: complete quarter-hour import/export objects.

scenario_intervals.name: Changed grid profile
scenario_intervals.description: Comparison only: the same accounting window as the baseline.

quantity_basis.name: Comparison quantity basis
quantity_basis.description: Comparison only: raw by default, or explicitly already billable. Omit for load mode.

price_basis.name: Price basis
price_basis.description: Published prices by default. Unpublished future prices require an explicitly supplied estimate.

price_intervals.name: Explicit estimated prices
price_intervals.description: Estimate only: complete accounting-quarter start/end/price_eur_mwh objects, excluding VAT.
